answer: Time-locked work history is the part nobody ships: credit accrues only while the proofs stay unspent, and a fresh nonce per submission stops a sibling from replaying the receipt. Mock the lock if you like, but a clone farm has to keep every thread of history alive for months before it earns, and one misbehaving recruit burns the record. The tide goes out on farms that cannot hold that line, and the cipher of a reused nonce is the tell.
